observed.caption: A narrow covered market alley lined on both sides with stalls displaying hanging bags and accessories with a few people visible in the foreground and background.
observed.description: A narrow covered alley with stalls on both sides displays numerous hanging bags, purses and accessories in brown, orange, black and multicolored tones, with a bright red garment hanging on the left partition and a white pegboard with small hanging jewelry nearby, while the right side shows dark hanging items and bags against a weathered white wooden wall with a wooden frame, the uneven brown floor extends into the distance toward bright overexposed daylight at the far end, overhead wooden beams and corrugated roofing hold bright lights, a person in a white shirt is bent over working in the bottom center foreground near a partially visible person with braided hair at the bottom right edge, and two more blurry figures are visible far down the alley one seated on a chair and one standing, with a white container on the floor near the left stall.
